facts.fact: The Minister of Gender, Children and Social Protection announced the 94th and 95th LEAP cash grant cycles from 25 March 2025, GHS 265.22 million for 350,000 households, paid through GhIPSS to beneficiaries' E-Zwich accounts.

facts.fact: The Minister said the Ghana National Household Registry's ongoing data collection supports targeting of new LEAP beneficiaries during the Ministry's reassessment of households.
